text.en:
The proposed staffing pattern of the Bureau of Customs with the corresponding salary rates
attached to the positions is hereby approved.

Any Customs officer or employee legally appointed to any of the positions enumerated in the
Revised Staffing Pattern shall be immediately entitled to the salary provided for said position, and the position
as stated in the approved appointment shall be the basis for identifying the individual position in the Bureau of
Customs. Such officer or employee shall perform the functions of the position to which he is legally

So much amount as may be needed to implement the provisions of this Decree is hereby deemed
appropriated.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
